title: Aira Force and Gowbarrow Park (National Trust, clockwise)

start.name: Aira Force National Trust main car park

stages.via: Welcome Building, picnic field, stone-wall gap, Glade
stages.check: Identify main car-park exit and Glade junction
Confirm waterfall bridge and optional lower bridge detour are not confused

stages.via: Upstream past High Force to High Cascades
stages.check: Cross wooden bridge at High Cascades, turn left at junction
At summit ascent junction turn right with wall on left
Trace summit spur and retrace to junction before continuing

stages.via: Old shooting lodge, Pooley Bridge junction
stages.check: Bear right at lodge and keep right at Pooley Bridge junction
Cross fence stile to seat, return over same stile, turn left
Left fork before woodland, through gate, bear left to car park
